title: Petition of Tennessee Gas Pipeline Company requesting authority from the Department of Public Utilities to take by eminent domain under G.L. Chapters 79 and 164, such rights-of-way, easements or other interests in land, or other property as may be necessary and have not been previously acquired, for the construction of a 4.4 mile loop in its gas transmission pipeline and appurtenant facilities situated in the Town of Southwick.
